description: Local seismic network REYKJANET is a dataset listed in EGDI Metadata Catalogue, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by ig.cas.cz. Digital records of seismic stations of local seismic network REYKJANET in the southeast tip of Iceland. The local network consists of 15 stations opearted jointly by the Institute of Geophysics CAS Prague and the Institute of Rock Structure and Mechanics CAS Prague. Coverage: the southeast tip of Iceland. Its keywords include seismologie, geofyzika, CzechGeo, geophysics, seismology. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geology-cz.
